# Lucachinou (Luca)

> 17-year-old French student learning AI to become an AI Engineer.
> Builds open-source Machine Learning projects with PyTorch: a RAG-based AI assistant,
> a Discord spam classifier, a house price regression model, and the Singlecraft
> Minecraft server dashboard.
> Main languages: Python, Rust and Java.

## Profile

- **Name**: Luca, known online as **Lucachinou**
- **Age**: 17 (born in 2009)
- **Nationality**: French
- **Role**: studying AI to become an AI Engineer, open-source contributor
- **Focus**: AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, RAG, regression,
  text classification
- **Languages spoken**: French, English
- **Website**: https://lucachinou.github.io/ (available in English and French)

## Skills

- **Python** (main language): Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Sentiment Analysis,
  automation (PyTorch, TensorFlow, SpaCy)
- **Java**: plugins and mods for Minecraft, back-end
- **JavaScript**: Discord bots (Node.js) and lightweight web interfaces
- **Rust**: system tools and performance

## Projects

1. [Assistant](https://github.com/Lucachinou/RAG-Assistant) (Beta): source code of the
   AI assistant integrated into his portfolio, based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented
   Generation). Tech: Python, RAG, Machine Learning.
2. [House Pricing Regression](https://github.com/Lucachinou/House-pricing-regression)
   (Release): educational regression model built with PyTorch that predicts house
   prices using only their size. Tech: Python, PyTorch, Machine Learning.
3. [Spam Classifier](https://github.com/Lucachinou/Spam-Classifier) (Release):
   PyTorch classification model that detects scam and spam messages, especially on
   Discord. Tech: Python, PyTorch, Machine Learning, NLP.
4. [Singlecraft](https://github.com/Lucachinou/Singlecraft) (Beta): open-source web
   dashboard for managing Minecraft servers: start, stop, restart and view live logs.
   Tech: Python, Web, Minecraft.

## Portfolio website

- **Sections**: Home, Projects, Skills, About

  about Luca, his projects and his stack.
- **Articles**: coming soon.
- **Languages**: English (default) and French, switchable from the header.

## FAQ

- **Who is Lucachinou?** Luca, a 17-year-old French student learning AI to become an
  AI Engineer. He works on machine learning with PyTorch, TensorFlow and SpaCy and
  publishes his projects as open source on GitHub.
- **What projects has he built?** Assistant (RAG-based AI assistant for his portfolio,
  beta), House Pricing Regression (educational PyTorch model), Spam Classifier
  (PyTorch scam detector for Discord messages) and Singlecraft (Minecraft server
  dashboard, beta).
- **Which languages does he use?** Python for ML/AI and automation, Java for Minecraft
  plugins and mods, JavaScript for Discord bots and web interfaces, Rust for system tools.
